entry_points.text: Step trap needs armed probe and address past slot; return checks trampoline; bug, flow, sanitizer and reserved traps classify and skip one instruction when surviving.
User breakpoint tries uprobe on reserved immediate then delivers trap signal; uprobe claims only when pre-step notifier claims.
Kernel breakpoint tries registered hook chain then faults.
32-bit handling covers direct BKPT and compat reads of Thumb halfwords or ARM word with masked encodings delivering trap signal.
Wrapper saves regs, swaps to runtime stack, marshals target and args, verifies platform register; recover restores stack from link register.
User-return trampoline funnels to syscall exit; generated fault handlers capture syndrome and never return, escalating to panic.
Stack dispatcher runs handler on dedicated interrupt stack and returns; tag routine compacts one page tags to sequential buffer.

exports.text: Power control reports runtime availability; corruption handler rate-limits diagnostic for clobbered reserved register and forwards status.
Stack top pointer is read-only after init; provisioning allocates thread-sized stack, warns and disables runtime on exhaustion.
Helpers count tag mappings, chain file offsets across headers, sum payload sizes, dump ranges in order aborting on first failure.
Allocator provides one page tag buffer with blocking semantics; dumping skips absent pages, shares one lazy buffer, fails on alloc or emit while releasing.
Hook combines firmware flag with address range to detect runtime faults, logs defect, taints, disables services, redirects return and counter.

hazards.text: Only one nesting level recoverable; hits while active or stepping bump missed counter, hit in reenter logs and traps fatally.

invariants.text: Kernel stepping needs IRQs disabled; enable sets saved and control step plus monitor, disable clears, query reads control, rewind and fastforward touch saved only.
User stepping uses thread flag; enable sets flag and saved-step, disable clears flag, register reset follows flag.

MMIO uses device or protected form; misaligned uses executable after code seen else nonexecutable; aligned maps RO/RX/RW/RWX; creation forces page granularity; misalign checks base and length unless sizes match.
Creator rejects init space, maps page-only to no-block and no-cont, dies on early failure; worker validates offset, rounds outward, walks directories.
Levels reuse via fixmap or allocate, zero with barrier, link with XN; warn on change, clear fixmap; huge block needs alignment and allowance, else perm-only updates.
Step entry saves masked IRQ bits then sets them, exit clears and restores; nested entry stashes outer value and restores on unwind; control holds status, mask, current pointer and previous record.
Helper revises code and data perms, skips misaligned, walks span; leaf forces RO and PXN from attrs, guarded-page only when exec allowed.
Empty slot needs allocator, installs cleared table; contiguity needs alignment, no veto and no noncont, then adds hint; temp mappings released once; bad descent is fatal; exhaustion aborts.
Block only for aligned allowed nontable chunk, else descend; populated slots perm-only, violations fatal; huge installers check safe transition and alignment.
Tag dumps activate on capable hardware for tag-enabled mappings; header count and size derive from filtered set with per-page tag storage.
Transitions pair tracking with tag and matrix handling; kernel suppresses tags on entry and masks faults on exit; user adds notes and ordered checks.
Privileged debug entry records IRQ state, marks disabled, enters NMI with tracing closed; exit restores conditionally.
Syscall entry leaves matrix payload, exits streaming, discards live vector and arms marker; exit clears marker once bound.
Per-CPU flag serializes workaround for flagged threads on affected CPUs, enabling step and debug then restoring; consume path masks faults; alt builds inert.
External helpers without named dossier include IRQ checks, probe control, warnings, page helpers, thread info, table ends, field extraction, bug reporting and config.

locks.text: Runtime mapping path holds fixmap mutex across whole range update.
Debug handling disables preemption across region, re-enables without reschedule, asserting RCU active.

state_machines.text: Dispatch looks up address, marks current and runs pre, arms step via slot or simulator; post restores address, marks done and clears; probe holds callbacks and slot.
Setup via thread or direct path under runtime lock, execution pinned on thread path, teardown closes user access before release; vector preserved, atomic use terminates.
Dispatch saves IRQ context, selects stack by identity, runs handler and restores.

structs.text: Sanitizer access size is one shifted left by syndrome masked to size bits.

Vetoes use NO_EXEC_MAPPINGS,NO_CONT_MAPPINGS and NO_BLOCK_MAPPINGS with INVALID_PHYS_ADDR and ENOMEM. Contiguity uses CONT_PTES,CONT_PMDS,CONT_PTE_MASK,CONT_PMD_MASK,PMD_MASK,PUD_MASK and PTE_CONT. Firmware uses EFI_RUNTIME_SERVICES_CODE,EFI_RUNTIME_SERVICES_DATA,EFI_MEMORY_RO,EFI_MEMORY_XP,PTE_RDONLY,PTE_PXN and PTE_GP. Tags and stacks use MTE_PAGE_TAG_STORAGE,PT_AARCH64_MEMTAG_MTE,VM_MTE,THREAD_SIZE and IRQ_STACK_SIZE. Exceptions use PSR_D_BIT,MDSCR_EL1_SS,MDSCR_EL1_KDE,SIGKILL and EFI_ABORTED.
Firmware descriptor carries physical base, page count, virtual base, attributes and type; permission carrier pairs descriptor with branch-target flag.
